data.one_liner: Generate Microsoft Word DOCX and PDF documents in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: A pure Dart library for generating and reading DOCX and PDF documents from a single document model. It supports rich text formatting, tables, lists, images, headers, and footers across all platforms without native dependencies.
use_when: You need to generate Microsoft Word or PDF files programmatically from Dart or Flutter.
You require cross-platform document generation without relying on native platform SDKs.
You want to share the same document model for both DOCX and PDF output formats.
avoid_when: You need complex PDF features like bidirectional text shaping, which are not supported for PDFs.
You require advanced layout rendering not expressible via the provided paragraph and table models.
strengths: Pure Dart with no native dependencies, making it work on iOS, Android, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Dual format generation (DOCX and PDF) from a single document model.
Lightweight with only a single dependency on the archive package.
weaknesses: PDF generator lacks support for certain DOCX-only features like headers, footers, right-to-left text, and images.
PDF support for Polish characters is partial due to font encoding limitations.
